sourceCounts.worldTwoRows: Fans First Booyah reports four World 2 stages with a level pattern starting at 140.

notes: Rows 1-13 use the named stage table from SpeedKeyboardEscape.wiki and are treated as the verified named World 1/main-route list for this pass.

World 2 rows are included only as route-order stage slots because the walkthrough verifies a four-stage World 2 and level pattern, but not distinct stage names, rewards, teleport costs, or clean row screenshots.
Wins rewards and teleport costs were sought in current public sources but were not visible as row-level values.
No clean row-specific stage screenshots were saved. Guide thumbnails, branded screenshots, arrows, callouts, and generic Roblox media were rejected.
unresolvedGaps: World 1 may have 13 to 15 stages according to the walkthrough, but only 13 named rows were source-listed.
World 2 row names, individual hazards, Win rewards, and teleport costs need in-game verification.
All 17 rows need clean stage/location screenshots before image coverage is complete.

items.name: Gummy Gateway
items.mainObstacles: Wide starter platforms and basic pathing
items.routeTip: Use this checkpoint to learn how your Speed changes movement before spending Wins on teleports.
items.sourceStatus: Named stage table verified; row values not in-game checked

items.name: Candy Cane Walk
items.routeTip: Stay centered and use short taps if your Speed makes the bridges feel slippery.
items.sourceStatus: Named stage table verified; row values not in-game checked

items.name: Chocolate Creek
items.routeTip: Line up jumps before touching pads, because extra Speed can throw you past the landing.
items.sourceStatus: Named stage table verified; row values not in-game checked

items.name: Marshmallow Maze
items.mainObstacles: Maze walls, wrong turns, and dead ends
items.routeTip: Slow down enough to read turns. Memorizing the route saves more time than sprinting blind.
items.sourceStatus: Named stage table verified; row values not in-game checked

items.name: Caramel Canyon
items.mainObstacles: Steep drops, speed ramps, and gap momentum
items.routeTip: Use ramp momentum for gaps, but reset your angle before the next platform.
items.sourceStatus: Named stage table verified; row values not in-game checked

items.name: Lollipop Ledge
items.routeTip: Tap movement instead of holding a direction when ledges become narrow.
items.sourceStatus: Named stage table verified; row values not in-game checked

items.name: Fudge Falls
items.routeTip: Watch one platform cycle before committing if your Speed makes recovery difficult.
items.sourceStatus: Named stage table verified; row values not in-game checked

items.name: Sprinkle Sprint
items.mainObstacles: Disappearing platforms and faster sprint sections
items.routeTip: Keep a steady rhythm over disappearing platforms instead of stopping on each one.
items.sourceStatus: Named stage table verified; row values not in-game checked

items.name: Truffle Tunnel
items.mainObstacles: Dark tunnel turns and sudden direction changes
items.routeTip: Learn the tunnel path at a controllable pace before trying full-speed clears.
items.sourceStatus: Named stage table verified; row values not in-game checked

items.name: Brainrot Boulevard
items.routeTip: Watch the chaser path and keep your turns calm instead of overcorrecting at high Speed.
items.sourceStatus: Named stage table verified; row values not in-game checked

items.name: Waffle Warp
items.routeTip: Face the next lane before entering a warp so the exit does not send you sideways.
items.sourceStatus: Named stage table verified; row values not in-game checked

items.name: Sugar Rush
items.recommendedLevel: Around level 100 to 120 for late World 1 sections
items.mainObstacles: Full-speed sections, precision jumps, and late-route maze pressure
items.routeTip: Zoom out for maze visibility and farm here only when you can clear it without repeated resets.
items.sourceStatus: Named stage table verified; late-route level range cross-checked

items.name: Cocoa Crown
items.recommendedLevel: Around level 100 to 120 for late World 1 sections
items.mainObstacles: Combined late-route obstacles and strict speed control
items.routeTip: Treat this as a control check. More Speed helps only if you can still steer through the final route.
items.sourceStatus: Named stage table verified; late-route level range cross-checked

items.name: World 2 Stage 1
items.routeTip: World 2 starts above the unlock level, so grind before entering if the first recommendation is still out of reach.
items.sourceStatus: World 2 count and first recommendation verified by walkthrough; row details incomplete

items.name: World 2 Stage 2
items.routeTip: Use treadmill time, rebirths, and multipliers before repeating this route if clears take too long.
items.sourceStatus: World 2 count and level pattern verified by walkthrough; row details incomplete

items.name: World 2 Stage 3
items.routeTip: Attempt this only after earlier World 2 clears feel consistent, because the route asks for another level jump.
items.sourceStatus: World 2 count and level pattern verified by walkthrough; row details incomplete

items.name: World 2 Stage 4
